startedBeforeGeneration.detail: Scheduled start is at or before this run's generatedAt, so no pre-event forecast can honestly be produced for it. It stays in the coverage denominator.

coverage.note: Games that had already started when this board was generated carry no pre-event forecast by design. They stay counted here so the day is never reported as fully covered when it was not.
